summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting the results of its September 10, 2026 Annual Meeting, including approval of the 2026 Stock Incentive Plan reserving 3,000,000 common shares and the cessation of grants under prior plans. The filing also references officer and director matters under Item 5.02 and bylaw amendments under Item 5.03. No special-situations transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or material definitive agreement with deal terms is disclosed in the excerpt. The event is a routine annual meeting and equity plan adoption, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, price per share, or closing timeline is stated.
